title: The Lantern in the Rain
premise: A young repairer discovers a lantern that lights when someone needs help.

chapters.title: The Light in the Workshop
beats: Mira finds an unfamiliar lantern among the objects left for repair.
The lantern lights as a neighbor knocks, asking for help finding a missing dog.
Mira decides to follow the lantern into the rain.

characters.name: Mira
characters.arc: Learns to trust her judgment when others need help.

places.name: Mira's workshop
places.description: A small repair shop in a rainy town.
